# BrillouinZones

> Python programs for constructing and drawing Brillouin zones of crystal lattices in two- and three-dimensional space, written for a condensed matter physics course. The 2D drawer renders the first several Brillouin zones of a lattice to a PNG using Pillow and sympy; the 3D drawer renders the first Brillouin zone of a reciprocal lattice (primitive, body-centered, face-centered, base-centered or hexagonal close-packed) as a matplotlib 3D plot.

Run `python3 "./2d Brillouin Zone/index.py"` or `python3 "./3d Brillouin Zone/index.py" <lattice-number 1..5>` after `pip3 install -r requirements.txt`. Set `MPLBACKEND=Agg` for headless rendering to files.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what the project is, how to install and run the drawers, example images
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): repository layout, how each script works, environment variables, tests and CI

## Code

- [2D entry point](2d%20Brillouin%20Zone/index.py): draws N Brillouin zones of a 2D lattice via Bragg-line intersections and flood fill
- [3D entry point](3d%20Brillouin%20Zone/index.py): draws the first Brillouin zone polyhedron of a chosen reciprocal lattice
- [3D geometry library](3d%20Brillouin%20Zone/geometry.py): Decimal-based points, vectors, planes, lines and their intersections

## Optional

- [Tests](tests/): pytest suite for lattice shells, geometry primitives and reciprocal lattices
- [CI workflow](.github/workflows/check.yml): compiles sources, runs tests, runs both drawers headless
